title: MOFA response to false claims in Chinese state media regarding meeting between leaders of China and Indonesia
text:
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) solemnly refutes the false statement made in a Chinese state media report issued following a meeting between Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto on November 20. In its coverage of the meeting, Chinese state media outlet Xinhua falsely claimed that Indonesia firmly adhered to a “one China policy” and recognized that Taiwan was a province of the People’s Republic of China (PRC).

A review of press releases issued by the Indonesian presidential office and Ministry of State Secretariat, as well as other official documents, found no such statement. This demonstrates that Chinese state media has once again presumed to speak on behalf of another country in an intentional and malicious attempt to undermine the sovereign status of Taiwan.

MOFA emphasizes that no matter how assertively or brazenly China spreads political narratives aimed at denigrating the sovereignty of the ROC (Taiwan), such efforts do not change the objective facts that the ROC (Taiwan) is a sovereign, democratic nation and that neither it nor the PRC is subordinate to the other.

MOFA urges the international community to hold to objective facts, acknowledge the Chinese Communist Party’s tactic of disseminating inaccurate statements, and work together to counter malicious acts that seek to twist the understanding of the international community through political coercion and the manipulation of information.
